questions.question_en: Did John the Baptist baptize Jesus in the Jordan River?
Did the Holy Spirit come down like a dove?
Was the voice from heaven angry with Jesus?
questions.question_ko: 하늘에서 들려온 목소리는 예수님께 화가 났었나요?
questions.feedback_en: No, God said He was very happy with Jesus!
questions.feedback_ko: 아니에요, 하나님은 예수님을 매우 기뻐하신다고 하셨어요!
